mapper.insert: INSERT INTO w16_handoff_request(request_id, match_id, first_actor, second_actor, activity_id, phase, team_id, blocker, dispatched, created_at, updated_at) VALUES(#{requestId}, #{matchId}, #{firstActor}, #{secondActor}, #{activityId}, #{phase}, #{teamId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{blocker,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dispatchedBit}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE w16_handoff_request SET dispatched=1, updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE request_id=#{requestId} AND dispatched=0 AND phase='UNKNOWN' AND (blocker IS NULL OR (blocker NOT LIKE '%NOT_ROLLED_BACK' AND blocker != 'CANCELLED_PREVENTED'))
